# MIUI Launcher Mod **The MIUI launcher, based on the CN build, with extra features and UI changes.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/stargazers)
> [!WARNING] > **Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated.** It's kept for MIUI 13–14 users. HyperOS users: see [HyperOS Launcher Mod](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Launcher). ## Features - New UI - Many extra options - Based on the CN launcher, tested on Global/CN/EU ROMs ## Requirements - MIUI 13–14, Android 11 or newer - Magisk ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Android 13 Global/CN ROMs: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs. ### Build from source ```sh git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod cd Miui_Launcher_Mod bash autobuild.sh # run `git pull` later to update ``` ## Screenshots

MIUI Launcher Mod

The MIUI launcher, based on the CN build, with extra features and UI changes.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/stargazers)

> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 13–14 users. HyperOS users: see HyperOS Launcher Mod.

Features

  • New UI
  • Many extra options
  • Based on the CN launcher, tested on Global/CN/EU ROMs

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 13–14, Android 11 or newer
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Android 13 Global/CN ROMs: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs.

    • Build from source

    git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Launcher_Mod
cd Miui_Launcher_Mod
bash autobuild.sh   # run `git pull` later to update
